notes.title: Internal Test started
notes.content:
We have started the internal Test for the latest Build.

New are:

Up to 4 AI Opponents.

1 level for Fire Attack and Bomb Attack on AI Competitors.
AI can perform Acts of Sabotage on Player's Oil Fields. Fire Attack or destruction of the Oil Field.
Raised Oil prices
Drilling prices lowered.
New Biome...Island.
Blocked Oil Wells. Blockage must be cleared before building can begin.

More is still in the planning stage.

notes.title: Security Upgrade
notes.content:
Here is a Blueprint for upgrading the oil fields.

Not final yet and prices are not fixed.

There is a Point for each Upgrade, which then together determines the value of the defense of the oil fields.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42886528/99f8e8b09f68a12ed582048da17c1f371c3c6be6.jpg[/img]

In addition, a level has been added in which you can also completely destroy the opponent's derrick. In the event of a successful sabotage, the opponent loses this oil well and must acquire it again.

Included so far:
1 level by burning and damaging structures of competitors' oil fields. The competitor loses part of its oil supply.

1 level by making the entire oil field unusable.

Upgrade system to protect your own oil fields from sabotage.

More information will follow shortly.

notes.title: New Event, New Tab in Laptop
notes.content:
A new event has been added:

It happens that the tanks leak and the soil is soaked with oil. As a result, no more oil will be pumped for a certain period of time.

The duration is displayed in the laptop as a small message and the tab for the oil supply.


New tab in the laptop

News :

Events are displayed here. When an oil well is on fire, an oil pump on the oil field has failed, or the oil has leaked from the tank. Here you can also travel directly to the place of action.


Miscellaneous:

Message on the interface when there is a new notification.

On the surface in the top left corner an indication of how many messages are in the inbox.

Minor bug fixes

EA start on 14.10.22 17:00

notes.title: Skill Tree for Main Camp and more....
notes.content:
Another update today.

Upgrades for keg filling line

The keg filling plant can now be accelerated in 4 stages in production.
Level 1 : -20% / Level 2 : -10% / Level 3 : -10% / Level 4 : -10%

With each level, the costs increase and depend on the expansion of the size of the barrel store.

In addition, tankers and a container vehicle were placed on the premises of the main storage facility.

The number of empty kegs is now limited to twice the amount by the size of the keg store.

A new button has been added to the bottling plant that automatically fills up the empty kegs to the maximum.

Added a minigame to the broken oil pump reset event.

The mouse speed can now be adjusted in the settings.

Several levels have been revised.

Minor and Major bugs and display errors have been fixed.

Added missing language translations.


Join to our Discord: https://discord.gg/ZeMZmVpMzt

notes.title: New sales system
notes.content:
The following changes have been made.

The sale of oil from the central warehouse has been revised. Tank vehicles must now be filled.
Changed the time it takes to fill oil drums.

Error removed: In some cases it happened that the pump could not be reset.


Added:

Tankers at the location: central warehouse.
Surface for filling tank vehicles.

What's planned?
I think the bottling line could use an upgrade. Maybe there is a company that can make our bottling plant a little faster. 



EA release 10/14/2022.

notes.title: New Function
notes.content:
New in the current update.

When drilling, the oil pump may not work properly. It must therefore be reset and restarted.

New event: Pump defective. Pump needs to be restarted.

Oil platforms revised.

Ocean maps revised.

Desert map revised.

Forest map revised.

Mountain map revised.


Central warehouse barrel filling plant has new mesh.

Various overlays have been adjusted.

Credit system revised.

Save game now has more slots. Previously it was only possible to have one saved game. Now it is possible to have 5 different scores.

Travel button to the central warehouse is no longer found in the laptop under the map, now in the laptop under central warehouse.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Complete revision of some widgets.

Load new pictures at the level.

Complete overhaul of the starting estate.

Give your company a name.

Many new assets have been added.

Console for bottling plant was renewed.

bugfixes.

What is being worked on?

Messages are coming in telling management that various pumps
no longer work and require repair. This should be tackled quickly, otherwise the production volume will fall.

notes.title: Bank and Credit System
notes.content:
A small interim update of the content that is currently being worked on.

It will be possible to take out a loan. You can also go bankrupt now.
How far you can go into the red depends on the oil supply in the tanks and in the main bearing.
Loan installments are deducted monthly, as are the running costs for the oil fields.

I'll keep you posted.

tanks.
